mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dm_openapi_idempotency (caller_uid, operation_path, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{callerUid}, #{operationPath}, #{idempotencyKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = idempotency_key
mapper.select:
SELECT request_hash, http_status, response_body FROM dm_openapi_idempotency WHERE
AND expire_time_ms > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_openapi_idempotency SET request_hash = #{record.requestHash}, http_status = #{record.httpStatus}, response_body = #{record.responseBody}, expire_time_ms = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 + #{retentionMs} WHERE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_openapi_idempotency WHERE expire_time_ms <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 ORDER BY expire_time_ms LIMIT #{limit}
